Summary

The family of linear functions includes functions of the form f(x) 5 ax 1 b,
where a and b are real numbers. The family of exponential functions includes
functions of the form f(x) 5 a ? bx, where a and b are real numbers, and b is
greater than 0 but is not equal to 1
